_comment: Written with AI assistance (Claude Code). See AI_USE.md. Science-value weights and transect geometry (PROMPT.md 4.9). Every value is a team choice (PLACEHOLDER) shown in the app's assumptions panel.

weights.label: PLACEHOLDER
weights.note: A station's score is the weighted mean of the terms that are available; a missing term's weight is set aside and reported.

role_values.label: PLACEHOLDER
role_values.note: How much each station type serves the fracture-to-hollow hypothesis; a crest point with no mapped fracture within 2 m counts as crest.

novelty_scale_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
novelty_scale_m.note: Novelty is min(1, distance to the nearest ChemCam target or drill hole / this).

access_scale_min.label: PLACEHOLDER
access_scale_min.note: Access is 1 - min(1, minutes to shelter / this).

transect_spacing_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
transect_spacing_m.note: Distance between transects along a crest.

wall_distance_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
wall_distance_m.note: PROMPT.md 4.9: 1 to 2 m down the flank.
